It removes a bypass-validation item because the new MO Validation Model addresses it. The Vietnam draft assumes a new Vietnam-located branch under SCB Singapore, new entity identity, FMRP flow only, no customized features, and strategic trade SI stamping. These assumptions describe a draft estimate, without branch approval or rollout evidence.

claim_register.claim: The generic list covers routing, LMS feed decisions, Murex batch configuration, Swift entity and BIC fields, release cutoff, accounting bridge account and branch codes, GUI dropdowns, and business-rule setup. New-entity Swift configuration includes sender BIC, field 53 for local-currency or over-account handling, field 58 for Flip MT202, receiver BIC for MT604/605, and branch mapping. Nostro setup uses legal entity and currency. Bulk initialization requires Ops-reviewed data and a Development change request; RTS GUI maintenance requires maker and checker. Ops-reviewed release cutoffs require deployment by change request. Bulk business rules use Ops-reviewed scripts and a change request; GUI rule maintenance requires maker and checker. The Vietnam list assigns UAT to Settlement Ops, regression/SIT to Development, and CPT to MO/Settlement Ops. It leaves Data Entitlement unfilled.

claim_register.claim: The older Hefei checklist routes EG, NP, SAUDI, and LOANIQ through legacy processing. The generic list and Vietnam draft retain only LOANIQ as legacy and place EG, NP, and SAUDI in strategic scope. Tranche 1 lists H2 group calculation at T-1 through T+1 and H1 at VD-1 through VD+9 for Murex. Tranche 2 uses default H2 configuration and marks that item not required. These are dated checklist differences, not one universal routing or horizon contract. Tranche and Hefei lists retain unresolved NDS or pending-fixing blacklists, old-versus-new SSI hierarchy, and conditional currency configuration. Role names in Done By columns do not prove completed work.

claim_register.claim: The Hefei setup sends cashflows to LMS and follows China head-office release times. It reuses global SSI. Branch-specific SSI is required for SUPPRESSXX auto-debit or over-account clients; external-client SSI is not expected in the stated scope. The page records an unresolved issue: Hefei-specific SSI flowed into MX2.11 as global. It lists no NSTP, plus FCY Swift-suppression and existing China-entity rule updates; Done labels are documentary statements, without inspected execution. The Tranche 3 checklist keeps Jersey release-cutoff currencies unchanged because users do not settle trades there. Jersey should not feed LMS; ZHENGZHOU and TAEYUAN should feed LMS.

claim_register.claim: The generic and FXO milestone lists are discovery inventories, not completed capability proof. They cover SI input, SSI/Nostro stamping, Swift and accounting, booking models, netting, static data, rules, migration, configuration, and go-live criteria. The generic list marks SGO-to-SGD stamping transformations and bilateral auto-netting unsupported. It records Murex-only NDS auto-netting, additional Stella IRS use cases, and unsupported cross-trade structure netting. It warns that unregistered financial fields may be dropped as non-financial amendments. It calls for translating Murex suppression rules to Stella, preventing duplicate payments during write-back trade migration, and updating FMMIS touch-point data for new actions. The FXO checklist expects exercise-generated FXD trades SUSPENDED, and expiry with settlement fee. These source-specific gaps and expected scenarios require scoped owner decisions.

claim_register.claim: The currency checklist requires review of legal-entity/currency release cutoff, mandatory Nostro data, precious-metal classification, booking-currency-to-ISO mapping for Swift and accounting, and tactical rounding configuration. It describes precious-metal classification as driving MT604/605/692. Its tactical rounding scope is H1 SG/MY/IN cashflow migration. Currency cutoff starts Swift generation after the cutoff and prevents further Settlement Ops handling under that source. The static page defines legal entity and currency as cutoff keys; a backward shifter derives the date. Cutoff time is GMT without calculation, while a queue shifter derives the RATAN-to-Razor release cutoff. Creation, update, and deletion use maker and checker; owner/profile fields remain blank. Limit static comprises numeric Limit and text Profile Name. Currency calendars source RDM.
